messages:
maria: Heads-up — reproduced a bundler+edge failure with the JS SDK. Errors: 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' or 'Unexpected token' when running in Vercel Edge / Cloudflare worker.
kevin: which package and which bundlers? vite/rollup/webpack?
maria: @redwood/inference-js v0.1.0. Repro shows up across Vite (SSR/edge target), Rollup bundling, and Webpack targeting webworker. Minimal repro below.
olivia: paste it please :eyes:
maria: minimal files:

package.json
{
  "name": "repro-edge-sdk",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": { "@redwood/inference-js": "0.1.0" }
}

// index.mjs
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js';
console.log(createClient());

When bundling for edge, import resolution sometimes pulls in dist/runtime.cjs.js or other CJS artifacts. Vite throws SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export' or Node-style import errors in the worker.

Workarounds that helped locally:
- Vite (SSR/edge): set optimizeDeps.include = ['@redwood/inference-js'] and ssr.noExternal = ['@redwood/inference-js']
- Webpack (webworker): add rule for .mjs and use type: 'javascript/auto'
- Rollup: ensure @rollup/plugin-commonjs wraps the dependency

kevin: likely an exports/conditional export mismatch and typings mismatch. Do we have the installed package.json from node_modules?
maria: package has main: dist/index.cjs.js, module: dist/index.esm.js, and an exports map but older releases didn't declare explicit "import"/"require" targets for the edge entry. Also types point to dist/index.d.ts which currently uses `export =` style.
sam: why does this only surface for edge runtimes?
maria: edge targets produce ESM/webworker output, and bundlers sometimes pick the wrong conditional export or fallback to the CJS file. Edge environments lack node shims so CJS runtime artifacts break.

alex: failing Rollup config to reproduce:

// rollup.config.js
export default {
  input: 'index.mjs',
  output: { format: 'es', file: 'bundle.js' },
  plugins: [require('@rollup/plugin-node-resolve').nodeResolve(), require('@rollup/plugin-commonjs')()]
}

If commonjs plugin doesn't convert some internal patterns, runtime throws. Older resolver logic can incorrectly pick dist/runtime.cjs.js when conditional exports are incomplete.

olivia: proposed action items:
1) create a tiny repro repo under devex repros
2) open SDK issue to fix package export map and types
3) add DX docs with bundler workarounds (vite/rollup/webpack snippets)

kevin: I'll own the SDK issue. Can you add the exact stack and package.json from node_modules into the issue?
maria: done — repro repo private: github.com/redwood/devex-repros/esm-edge-1845061234. Summary: bundlers occasionally inject dist/runtime.cjs.js into ESM bundles.

sam: short-term consumer patch: import the ESM file directly: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.esm.js'` or force bundler to prefer module field.

alex: types fix: change d.ts to ESM-friendly exports (named exports) instead of `export =`. Also publish types under conditional exports mapping.

maria: I opened issue #342 on the SDK repo, labeled bug/bundler/edge/types and added the repro and configs. ci-bot kicked off a bundler matrix run.
ci-bot: ci check started for issue branch: redwood/inference-js#342 10: running matrix: vite/rollup/webpack.

kevin: will add explicit exports fields for "import" and "require", fix types, and publish a patch. Also add an e2e bundler smoke for edge in CI.

olivia: I'll draft the docs snippet with Vite ssr.noExternal example and Rollup/webpack notes.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup: drop any other logs here if you hit variations.
kevin: will post PR link when ready :shipit:
